author: andyschofield
quote:
Man tbh idk really what to say. This is such a huge disappointment coming from a fan who bought GTA 4 in 2010 
The old GTA games have this dark comedic aura to them that made me get glued to the game and genuinely enjoy it and get addicted. 
This new game, it's completely gone. It's basically GTA world with a weird relationship and good boy aspect so you can't be a bad guy.
And the jokes they try to do in this game are on par with Scary Movie 5. Just unbelievable that's all I can say.
Hopefully we can get a new game with different developers very soon.
